name: @lolly-tools/docs-render
description: The shared, DOM-free docs render layer: the markdown->HTML renderer, doc primitives (cols/timeline/figure/masthead/provenance-pills), icon/logo data, and the DocsRenderContext capability bridge. Consumed by BOTH the static site generator (docs/build.ts) and the in-app live docs view (shells/web) so the two can never drift.
